Car Presentation – Brazil Grand Prix 
McLaren Mastercard F1 Team 
 
  Updated component Primary reason for update Geometric differences compared to previous version  Brief description on how the update works (min 20, max 100 words) 
1 Front Wing Performance - Flow Conditioning New Front Wing 
A completely new front wing design, aimed at 
improved flow conditioning towards the floor and 
bodywork resulting in improved aerodynamic 
performance. 
2 Rear Wing Performance – Local Load New Rear Wing Assembly A new rear wing assembly has been designed for this event, aiming to increase aerodynamic load efficiently in all conditions. 
3 Beam Wing  Performance - Flow Conditioning New Beam Wing  In conjunction with the aforementioned rear wing, a new beam wing has been designed for improved interaction and flow conditioning. 
4 Floor Furniture Performance - Flow Conditioning Updated Floor Furniture 
A small modification to the floor furniture, resulting 
in better flow conditioning and resultant 
improvement of aerodynamic performance of the 
floor.
